Anna P (partnerships): Heads-up — we're assembling a small "marketplace connector" IAAC playbook: reference arch, terraform modules, and packaging notes for AWS/GCP marketplaces. Goal: first draft by end of next sprint.
Matt H (infra): Nice. Will this include Dedicated & Private deployment notes (VPC peering, subnets, routing)?
Anna P (partnerships): Yes — minimal network patterns + example VPC/NAT, plus a checklist for market listing requirements.
Raj S (solutions): Suggest we include a small sample app manifest + helm chart example for the private deployment path. E.g., how to stitch service account / secret rotation with KMS.
Jessica L (cloud-eng): Agreed on KMS bits. Also need to call out marketplace packaging caveats: e.g., GCP images must pass license scan, AWS needs CloudFormation transform for listing. I'll add a short "gotchas" section.
Raj S (solutions): Draft terraform module snippet I started — please sanity-check: 
```hcl
module "redwood_marketplace_connector" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-iaac//modules/connector"
  providers = { aws = aws }
  kms_key_id = var.kms_key_id
  enable_marketplace_listing = true
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id
}
```
Matt H (infra): Looks fine. Need to parameterize instance types/accelerator profile for Dedicated. Also include autoscaling policy examples (SLO-driven).
Anna P (partnerships): For docs structure I'm thinking: 1) Overview + decision tree 2) Reference arch diagrams (hosted/dedicated/private) 3) Terraform modules + usage examples 4) Packaging checklist per cloud 5) Test & validation harness (CI triggers) 6) Ownership & contact matrix. Thoughts?
Jessica L (cloud-eng): That's a good flow. For tests: include a github actions workflow that runs `terraform init && plan` against a tiny smoke account, and a job that runs our internal model-serving smoke test. We should include a deploy-bot friendly tag so the CI can report status.
deploy-bot: CI: marketplace-iaac/validate-plan — succeeded for branch: feature/marketplace-playbook (run: 2027-05-12T14:08:20Z) :white_check_mark:
Anna P (partnerships): Perfect. Raj, can you own the TF modules? Jessica — docs + packaging gotchas. Matt — reference arch + infra examples. I'll coordinate with partner PMs and draft the public checklist.
Raj S (solutions): I can own modules. Will push initial module layout + README by Tue.
Jessica L (cloud-eng): I'll start a docs PR with the packaging checklist and add the GCP/AWS notes.
Matt H (infra): I'll sketch diagrams and add sample autoscaling policies.
Anna P (partnerships): Action items consolidated here: 
- Raj: TF modules prototype (due Tue)
- Jessica: Packaging gotchas + docs PR (due Wed)
- Matt: Reference arch diagrams + autoscale examples (due Wed)
- Anna: Partner checklist + sync with partner PMs (due Fri)
Please drop PR links in this thread when ready. Also small ask: keep module inputs minimal — aim for useful defaults so partners can test quickly. :thumbsup:
Matt H (infra): Will do. Also adding a small CI job to run `tflint` and `tfsec` in the repo.
Anna P (partnerships): Thanks team. Quick sync on Thu 9:30 PT? If that works I'll add calendar invite and include partner-ops.
Raj S (solutions): Works for me.
Jessica L (cloud-eng): Works.
Matt H (infra): Yep.
Anna P (partnerships): Great — I'll send invite.
